faqs.question: What is Honest Second Opinion?
faqs.answer: Honest Second Opinion is a doctor-led review of your diagnosis, scans, reports, and proposed treatment plan designed to help you understand whether surgery is truly needed, what alternatives exist, and what the safest next step could be.

faqs.question: Why should I take a second opinion?
Which conditions can I get reviewed?
faqs.answer: You can reach out to us for conditions spanning:
bullets: Orthopaedic issues (knee, shoulder, spine, joint pain)
General surgery conditions such as hernia, piles, gallstones
Vascular conditions such as varicose veins

faqs.question: What reports should I upload?
faqs.answer: Please upload all necessary information to help us understand your concern completely. This can include:
faqs.answerSuffix: You can upload multiple files together.

faqs.question: Can surgery really be avoided?
faqs.answer: In many cases, yes. Some conditions improve with medication, physiotherapy, lifestyle changes, monitoring, or minimally invasive treatment. If surgery is necessary, we'll tell you honestly.

faqs.question: Is the second opinion really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reviewing your reports and sharing an honest opinion is completely free, with no obligation to book treatment or travel with us.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get my second opinion?
faqs.answer: In most cases you will receive a specialist's response within 24 hours of sharing complete reports. Complex cases may take up to 48 hours.

faqs.question: What if I don't have all my reports?
faqs.answer: Send what you have. Our care team will tell you exactly which test or report the specialist needs before giving a reliable opinion.

faqs.question: Who reviews my reports?
faqs.answer: Your case is reviewed by a senior, board-certified specialist in the relevant field at one of our accredited partner hospitals in India.

faqs.question: Will you share my medical data with anyone else?
faqs.answer: No. Your reports are shared only with the reviewing specialist and the hospital you approve. We follow strict data protection practices.

faqs.question: What happens after I receive the opinion?
faqs.answer: The choice is yours. If treatment is recommended and you wish to proceed, we provide a full cost estimate, visa assistance, and travel planning. If not, you simply have peace of mind — free of charge.
